results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if destination tab titles may be unknown/renamed)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch current tab titles using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SHEET_NAMES (use returned titles exactly when building sheet-qualified A1 ranges; quote titles with spaces/symbols).

[Optional (if writing near grid limits or doing large blocks)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect row/column capacity and numeric sheet identifiers using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO (detect out-of-bounds targets early).
[Optional (if targeting a moving row via a stable key)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the destination row using GOOGLESHEETS_LOOKUP_SPREADSHEET_ROW (translate the match into concrete A1 ranges).
[Optional (to prevent accidental overwrite or confirm placement)] [Prerequisite]: Preview bounded target windows using GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET (expect empty trailing cells/rows to be omitted).

[Optional (if any target range exceeds current grid size)] [Prerequisite]: Expand rows/columns using GOOGLESHEETS_INSERT_DIMENSION (then re-preview with GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET if placement is critical).

[Required] [Step]: Write one or many ranges using GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH (set valueInputOption; each data[].values must be a rectangular 2D array; for high volume, chunk into multiple calls—optionally in COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH).
[Fallback (if the batch fails due to a single bad block)] [Fallback]: Retry only the failing block using GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE (single explicit A1 range with matching 2D values shape).

[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Validate per-range receipts from GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH (responses[*].updatedRange/updatedCells; updatedRange may return quoted tab names) and spot-check with GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH] Strict schema: valueInputOption and data are required; every data[].values must be 2D (a single cell is 1x1) or the call can fail with HTTP 400.
[GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH] Range-parse HTTP 400 commonly comes from tab-title mismatches or missing quoting for titles with spaces/symbols.
[GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH] Dimension mismatch (values matrix larger than the declared A1 range) can hard-fail with HTTP 400; align range height/width to the matrix.
[GOOGLESHEETS_INSERT_DIMENSION] Requires the correct nested request wrapper and a numeric sheet identifier from GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO; using only a tab title can fail validation.

[GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH] Large writes can hit 429 or transient 503/timeouts; use smaller batches (often tens to low-hundreds of ranges per call) and retry with backoff; 403 indicates missing edit permission.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Chunk a large write-set into multiple GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH calls
Normalize ragged rows into a rectangle (prevents width mismatches)
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def rect(v):
  w=max((len(r) for r in v),default=0)
  return [list(r)+['']*(w-len(r)) for r in v]
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Google Sheets is a cloud-based spreadsheet tool enabling real-time collaboration, data analysis, and integration with other Google Workspace apps. STRICT RATE LIMITS apply - max 60 reads/minute and 60 writes/minute. Exceeding this causes errors.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=googlesheets. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="googlesheets") to create a connection BEFORE executing any googlesheets tools.

GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH.description: Tool to set values in one or more ranges of a spreadsheet. Use when you need to update multiple ranges in a single operation for better performance.

range.description: The A1 notation of the range to update (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B2', 'Sheet1!C:C', or 'A1:D5'). The range must specify which cells to update.

values.description: The data to write. This is an array of arrays, the outer array representing all the data and each inner array representing a major dimension. Each item in the inner array corresponds with one cell. Supports string, number, boolean, and null values.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. ROWS (default) means each inner array is a row of values. COLUMNS means each inner array is a column of values.

items.description: Data within a range of the spreadsheet.

data.description: The new values to apply to the spreadsheet. Each ValueRange specifies a range and the values to write to that range. Multiple ranges can be updated in a single request.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. This ID can be found in the URL of the spreadsheet (e.g., https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit). Must be a valid Google Sheets spreadsheet ID.

valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted. RAW: Values are stored exactly as entered, without parsing. USER_ENTERED: Values are parsed as if typed by a user (numbers stay numbers, strings prefixed with '=' become formulas, etc.). INPUT_VALUE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default input value option is not specified.

includeValuesInResponse.description: Determines if the update response should include the values of the cells that were updated. By default, responses do not include the updated values.

responseValueRenderOption.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. FORMATTED_VALUE (default): Values are formatted as displayed in the UI. UNFORMATTED_VALUE: Values are unformatted. FORMULA: Formulas are not evaluated.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. SERIAL_NUMBER (default): Dates are returned as numbers. FORMATTED_STRING: Dates are returned as formatted strings.

GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SHEET_NAMES.description: Lists all worksheet names from a specified Google Spreadsheet (which must exist), useful for discovering sheets before further operations.

exclude_hidden.description: When True, hidden sheets will be excluded from the results. When False (default), all sheets including hidden ones are returned. Hidden sheets are sheets that have been hidden via the 'Hide sheet' option in Google Sheets UI.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet (alphanumeric string, typically 44 characters). Extract only the ID portion from URLs - do not include leading/trailing slashes, '/edit' suffixes, query parameters, or URL fragments. From 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qpyC0XzvTcKT6EISywY/edit#gid=0', use only '1qpyC0XzvTcKT6EISywY'.

GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO.description: Retrieves metadata for a Google Spreadsheet using its ID. By default, returns essential information (ID, title, sheet properties) to avoid payload size issues. Use the fields parameter for comprehensive metadata or specific fields.

fields.description: Optional. Field mask specifying which fields to return. Uses Google's field mask syntax (comma-separated, dot-notation for nested fields). If not specified, a default mask returning common fields (spreadsheet ID, title, sheet properties) is applied to avoid payload size issues. For full metadata, use '*' (not recommended for large spreadsheets). When set, includeGridData is ignored. Examples: 'sheets.properties(sheetId,title)', 'properties.title,sheets.properties.sheetId'.

ranges.description: Optional. The ranges to retrieve from the spreadsheet, specified using A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D5', 'Sheet2!A1:C4'). Multiple ranges can be requested simultaneously. If not specified, metadata for the entire spreadsheet is returned without grid data.

spreadsheet_id.description: Required. The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID or full URL. Accepts either the ID alone (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms') or a full Google Sheets URL (e.g., 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms/edit'). The ID will be automatically extracted from URLs. Note: Published/embedded URLs (containing '/d/e/2PACX-...') are not supported.

include_grid_data.description: Optional. If true, grid data will be returned. This parameter is ignored if a field mask was set in the request. When false or not specified, only metadata is returned without cell values.

exclude_tables_in_banded_ranges.description: Optional. If true, tables within banded ranges will be omitted from the response. Default is false when not specified.

GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET.description: Retrieves data from specified cell ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.
